name: Mission & Architectural Philosophy
description: Create a high-end auteur cinematography showcase inspired by 35mm archival film and Swiss editorial typography. Enforce architectural restraint: avoid cheap neon glows, oversaturated gradients, and childish AI aesthetic defaults.
designPhilosophy: Create a high-end auteur cinematography showcase inspired by 35mm archival film and Swiss editorial typography
implementationApproach: Instead, emphasize deep obsidian backgrounds (#090A0F), subtle matte graphite card elevations (#12141C), warm off-white editorial serif typography (#F3F4F6), and 0.5px hairline metallic dividers.
performanceConsiderations: Utilize translate3d, will-change sparingly, and clamp animation timelines under 600ms.
accessibilityRequirements: Provide prefers-reduced-motion override and ensure WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard focus visibility.
